name: Pakistan
famous_for: K2 mountain (world's second-highest, 8,611m), Hunza Valley, Mughal Badshahi Mosque in Lahore, truck art, and spicy Biryani.
tourists: Over 1.9M international visitors; highlights include Karakoram Highway ('Eighth Wonder'), Fairy Meadows, and Mohenjo-daro ruins.
must_know: Pakistani truck art transforms commercial cargo trucks into moving kaleidoscopic masterpieces of floral calligraphy and mirrors.
fun_fact: The Karakoram Highway links Pakistan to China through the Khunjerab Pass at 4,693m, the highest paved international border crossing.
